answer: Escrowed-bond referral graph: a new identity locks a 50 POA onyx bond in a referral graph, blocking bulk fakes. The graph grows like an orchard: each branch shows its voucher, and the ledger mirrors every link, flagging star-shaped clusters. For 10 epochs any peer may challenge; a proven fake loses its bond and the challenger earns half. Making 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA; one honest agent pays 50 POA once and keeps its reward share.
